=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/stage_switches.json:396-401 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The rewritten `stage` text for `MERGE_LEASE_CONFLICT_RELEASE_ENABLED` now starts "Merge-lease ready-first grant (issue #10098, Phase 1 of docs/plans/merge-lease-short-critical-section-plan.md)". That is the label of `MERGE_LEASE_READY_GRANT_ENABLED` (about line 415), but this switch gates conflict release (`_merge_lease_conflict_release_enabled`, scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3997-4003). Related: changelog.d/merge-lease-short-cs-p2-delta-ci.md:10 wrongly says the PR "registers" both switches, when the diff only rewrites their existing stage text and adds on_values.
  WHY: The STAGE_SWITCH_OFF alert copies this stage text into the Telegram WARNING and the job-summary table, so it sends operators to the wrong stage. Severity disagreement: sonnet and gpt rated it NIT, gemini and minimax rated it MAJOR; the highest (MAJOR→high) is used.
- README.md:158 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The "Used By" column of the new `MERGE_BASE_SYNC_DELTA_CI_ENABLED` row lists only `ci, review_autofix`. It leaves out `orchestrate_poll`, which also reaches `_pr_base_sync_dispatch_final_ci` through `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge`.
  WHY: Documentation only. After a rollback, operators who see failed `[sync-quick]` runs (`reason=delta_disabled`) from poller ticks cannot trace them to the right source.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2280 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: Only `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (lines 5018 and 5025) exports `MERGE_BASE_SYNC_DELTA_CI_ENABLED`. In review_autofix.yml and orchestrate_poll.yml the dispatcher always sees the default `true`.
  WHY: With the variable set to `false`, each update head still gets one `[sync-quick]` run that fails with `delta_disabled` before the full run starts. Rollback still works at the cost of one extra failed run per PR; this is a disclosed, known residual that follows the MERGE_BASE_SYNC_QUICK_CI_ENABLED pattern.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:1181-1234 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Neither review_autofix.yml (the deterministic-skip-merge env block) nor orchestrate_poll.yml (301-315, 1609-1612, 1869-1872, 2035-2038) exports `MERGE_BASE_SYNC_DELTA_CI_ENABLED`, so the dispatcher at scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2280 defaults it to "true".
  WHY: Setting `vars.MERGE_BASE_SYNC_DELTA_CI_ENABLED=false` does not stop the dispatcher from requesting quick runs, so the steady-state rollback never arrives. The tests at tests/test_ci_sync_quick_delta.py:243-272 inject the variable directly and hide the gap.
- scripts/ci_sync_quick.sh:285-297, 321-323, 399-401 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The cap check counts the raw selected paths before the safety filter drops paths that are not safe to run (for example, files other than .py/.sh).
  WHY: Delta mode can hit `delta_selection_too_large` and abort to a full CI run even when the number of runnable tests is well under the cap.
- scripts/ci_sync_quick.sh:376, 388 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `ci_sync_quick_run_tests` runs `git diff ... base_tip..update_head` at line 376, and `ci_sync_quick_overlap` (line 388) runs the same diff again.
  WHY: This is a minor performance cost with no correctness impact: one wasted `git diff` per `[sync-quick]` run.
- scripts/ci_sync_quick.sh:417-419 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `bash "${listed_path}"` runs a path from the pre-push selector without checking the script's content.
  WHY: The path itself is constrained (relative, no `..`, existing file), but any shell code inside a selected test file runs with repository-write privileges.
- scripts/ci_sync_quick.sh:208-214 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The delta switch parsers in `ci_sync_quick_delta_enabled` and scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2280-2293 lowercase the value but do not strip whitespace, unlike the lease-switch parsers at scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3991 and 3999.
  WHY: A value with surrounding whitespace reads as off and silently falls back to the full suite, defeating delta mode without a log line that names the bad value. Sonnet and gemini raised the same point as hardening suggestions only.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Set `sync_quick="true"` … only when … `MERGE_BASE_SYNC_DELTA_CI_ENABLED` is on." / "Rollback: `MERGE_BASE_SYNC_DELTA_CI_ENABLED=false`."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml deterministic-skip-merge job env block (around line 1214), and the matching call sites in .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml (lines 301, 1609, 1869, 2035)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: Evidence: neither workflow exports the variable to the process running scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh; the dispatcher at scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2280 defaults an unset value to "true"; only ci.yml's verification steps receive the repository variable; the tests at tests/test_ci_sync_quick_delta.py:243-272 inject the variable directly and so mask the gap; the README row also omits orchestrate_poll. Severities: gemini BLOCKER, minimax MAJOR, gpt NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 said this is not a gap, because issue step 5 asks only for the ci.yml env and files_touched excludes review_autofix.yml.
- requirement: "Register the `CI_SYNC_QUICK` prefix under 'Stable log prefixes (contractual)' only if it is not already there."
  expected_change_site: agents.d/merge-lease-short-cs-p2-delta-ci.md
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The fragment has only a "Workflow architecture" block, with no prefix registry bullet or key. minimax_minimax-m3 and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disagree: the prefix is already registered in agents.d/9642-merge-base-sync-churn.md (lines 11-12 and 14-15), so nothing was required.
- requirement: "Update `tests/test_ci_sync_quick.py` and any CI-structure test that pins the `tests-sync-quick` timeout or env lines."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_ci_docs_only_final_ci.py and tests/test_ci_poll_test_sharding.py
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: These tests were not changed for the new env exports. minimax_minimax-m3 and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disagree: those files do not pin tests-sync-quick env lines, tests/test_ci_job_split_contract.py:50 was updated, and tests/test_ci_sync_quick_delta.py:311-312 pins the new env lines.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/stage_switches.json:396-401 (MERGE_LEASE_CONFLICT_RELEASE_ENABLED entry) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new stage text begins "Merge-lease ready-first grant (issue #10098, Phase 1 ...)", but the switch drives `_merge_lease_conflict_release_enabled` (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3997-4003). Two switches now share one stage name. The on_values additions are correct. Related: changelog.d/merge-lease-short-cs-p2-delta-ci.md:10 wrongly says the PR "also registers" both entries.
  WHY: The daily stage switch watch in `collect-logs` copies this text into the Telegram WARNING and job summary, so it names the wrong stage. Suggested fix: change the lead to "Merge-lease conflict release (issue #10098, ...)" and correct the changelog wording.
- README.md:158 (MERGE_BASE_SYNC_DELTA_CI_ENABLED row, "Used By" `ci, review_autofix`) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: orchestrate_poll also reaches the dispatcher (`_pr_base_sync_dispatch_final_ci`, pr_checks_lib.sh:2280), via orchestrate_poll_process.sh lines 3223, 30552, 34566, 36683 and others. review_merge_train.sh:3175 and review_rb_judge.sh:2828 call it too.
  WHY: Documentation only. After a rollback, operators see failed `[sync-quick]` runs (`reason=delta_disabled`) from poller ticks with no listed source.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2280 (`_pr_base_sync_dispatch_final_ci`) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Only .github/workflows/ci.yml (lines 5018 and 5025) exports the switch. review_autofix.yml and orchestrate_poll.yml do not, so the dispatcher there always sees `true`.
  WHY: Each update head with a non-wiring overlap still gets one `[sync-quick]` run that fails with `delta_disabled`, after which the full run starts. This is disclosed in the README, agents fragment and changelog, and it is a known residual that matches MERGE_BASE_SYNC_QUICK_CI_ENABLED, not a regression.
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE. Checked: the CI_SYNC_QUICK prefix is already in agents.d/9642-merge-base-sync-churn.md:12 and :15; the new test file runs via the tests-system-python catch-all; tests/test_ci_job_split_contract.py:50 and :182 and tests/test_ci_sync_quick.py:788-802 are updated or still valid; exporting to the review workflows is outside step 5 and files_touched.
- HARDENING: scripts/ci_sync_quick.sh ci_sync_quick_delta_enabled (about line 210) and scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2280 do not strip whitespace before lowercasing. Fix: add `| tr -d '[:space:]'` at both sites (2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
